title.suggested: McCoole and Gallagher make a match; Allen said to retire

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Mike McCoole and James C. Gallagher, recently beaten by Allen, made a $1,000 match, and that Allen had on good authority retired from the ring to attend to his saloon.

facts.fact: Allen was reported to have permanently retired from the ring to attend to his saloon business

notes: Current title says 'considers retirement' but the paper says he 'has permanently retired'. Most of the item is the McCoole-Gallagher match, made at Aleck McKee's on Chestnut street.
